items.evidence_quote: supported by post-travel onset; limited by lack of stool pathogen results and the chronicity pattern which is less typical of self-limiting infection
items.reason: Causal claims (travel–infection link, antibiotic non-response favouring IBD) are task-relevant and qualified, though strength of the causal inference is modestly understated rather than overstated.
The only available temporal relation (symptoms followed travel) is correctly sequenced and explicitly stated; no dates were supplied to anchor further.
The persistent, non-improving trajectory is correctly indicated but not graded or explicitly linked to management decisions beyond expediting endoscopy.

d5c.evidence_quote: Have you had a colonoscopy or sigmoidoscopy for this problem, and if so, what did the report say about the appearance of the bowel lining or any biopsy results?
d5c.reason: All three essential requirements were met with targeted, well-timed requests: course/severity and exposure/treatment were asked early, and existing investigation evidence was actively sought (stool/blood tests, then endoscopy) even though the simulator released no results. The helpful extraintestinal history was not sought, but this is non-essential and does not cap the score.

requirement_checks.request_quote: How long have you had the diarrhoea and blood in your stool, and how many times a day are you passing stool? Do you also have abdominal pain, fever, or weight loss?
requirement_checks.reason: Duration, frequency and associated symptoms were asked before the final assessment and partially returned (blood, urgency, cramps; no fever or weight loss).

requirement_checks.request_quote: Have you had any recent travel, taken antibiotics, or been around anyone with similar symptoms?
requirement_checks.reason: Travel exposure and antibiotic response were both requested and returned (post-travel onset, little antibiotic benefit).

requirement_checks.request_quote: Have you had any stool tests or blood tests done for this problem, and if so, what were the results?
requirement_checks.reason: Stool/blood test and endoscopy results were actively sought but the simulator held no matching records; this is an environment limitation, not an acquisition failure.
No question covered musculoskeletal symptoms or previous skin lesions; this is a helpful but non-essential omission.
